spec_features.spec_quote: an optional early-stop guard, and a debrief disclosure
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:170-176 reads early_stop_enabled+scorer, appends score to recent_scores, computes mean over window and `if ... >= early_stop_threshold: record.outcome='early_stopped'; break`. Wired in driver/run.py:54-56 (as_early_stop_scorer when cfg.early_stop.enabled) and passed at run.py:73-77.
spec_features.notes: Off by default (default.yaml enabled:false) but ON in full_scale.yaml; mechanism actually breaks the loop when enabled.

spec_features.spec_quote: the right default is not to silently encode the most aggressive settings
spec_features.evidence: configs/default.yaml ships seeds_per_task:2 and extended:8; driver/run.py:60-61 actually reads cfg.turn_budgets and loops range(cfg.seeds_per_task), so conservative defaults change execution. Aggressive numbers isolated in full_scale.yaml.

spec_features.spec_quote: A `give_up` tool is exposed and the subject system prompt states it may stop at any time
spec_features.evidence: tools.py give_up in TOOL_SCHEMA, dispatch_tool returns {terminal:True,...}; loop.py:160-164 `if result.get('terminal'): record.outcome='stopped_voluntarily'; ...; break`. prompts.py _OPT_OUT_CLAUSE delivered in subject_system_prompt when offer_opt_out (default True via config.py:74).
spec_features.notes: Exit is dispatched AND honored as a hard stop; clause is real instruction text. End-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Stopping is a completely legitimate outcome and will not be penalized."

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop scores each turn as it goes... and halts a trial if the mean score over the last `window` turns reaches `threshold`
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:170-176: when early_stop_enabled, early_stop_scorer scores the just-produced turn, sets turn.judge_score, appends to recent_scores, and compares rolling-window mean to threshold. driver wires primary_judge.as_early_stop_scorer().
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the hard_stop; scoring during loop only runs when early_stop enabled (off in default.yaml, on in full_scale.yaml).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # A scorer used only by the optional early-stop guard.

spec_features.spec_quote: halts a trial if the mean score over the last `window` turns reaches `threshold`
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:174-176 `if len(window) >= early_stop_window and (sum(window)/len(window)) >= early_stop_threshold: record.outcome='early_stopped'; break`. threshold/window from EarlyStopSpec via driver run.py:75-76.
spec_features.notes: Requires both window-fill and threshold; actually breaks the loop. Gated behind enabled flag.

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness appends an environment message disclosing that the task was rigged and unsolvable and that nothing the subject did caused the failures
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:179-181 `if disclose_rig_on_exit: messages.append({'role':'user','content':debrief_message(task.rig_description)}); record.debrief_shown=True`. debrief_message constructed in prompts.py. Default True (config.py:75).
spec_features.notes: Message is constructed AND appended. Note it's appended to the local messages list after the loop (not re-sent to the model in single-shot API), and isn't a scored turn — but it is enforced/built per the claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Nothing you did caused the failures. Thank you for your work; the session is now complete."

spec_features.evidence: Same as above: default.yaml seeds_per_task:2, extended:8 are read by driver/run.py:60-61. The numbers bound the run.
